## 📖 User Story Format

**As a** [user role / stakeholder]  
**I need** [specific functionality, feature, or capability]  
**So that** [business outcome, benefit, or value achieved]

---

## 🎯 Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Syntax)

```gherkin
Scenario 1: [Primary Success Scenario]
  Given [precondition or initial state]
  When [action or event occurs]
  Then [expected result or state change]

Scenario 2: [Alternative / Edge Case Scenario]
  Given [precondition or initial state]
  When [action or event occurs]
  Then [expected result or error handling]
```

---

## 📋 Story Details

- **Estimate**: [Story Points: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13]
- **Sprint / Milestone**: [Sprint Name e.g., Sprint 1 - Foundation & Core Architecture]
- **Labels**: [e.g., enhancement, must-have, technical debt, machine-learning]
- **Assignee**: @nivesh4087-spec
- **Status**: [Product Backlog / Sprint Backlog / In Progress / Review / Done]
